releaseNotes: Expanded Stats: rolling 7-day/8-week views, 730-day history, habits, daily goals, streaks, eight milestones, per-book dates and WPM-based time remaining. Preserves legacy totals; sync clock to start dated history. Complete/Fast refresh setting, full sleep pre-clear, detailed OTA failure stages. Includes prior wireless EPUB image preparation. Test release; physical UI/panel validation pending. Statistics formats extended; older firmware may drop new history fields on downgrade.
